_comment: FULL 3-YEAR test for opt1hyear-results. Replays the top-N configs per coin over the entire available history: 2023-08-01 (or the coin's listing date) through today. Unlike holdout1h/, this window OVERLAPS the optimizer's own window.
_important: 2023-08-01 -> 2025-07-19 is genuinely out-of-sample. 2025-07-20 -> today is the period these configs were SELECTED on, so that portion is in-sample and flattering by construction. report.py splits the two so the distinction stays visible.
_sizing: Account starts at $1000 and every trade uses a FIXED $1000 notional (qty_pct_equity forced to 0). No compounding, no leverage effect. net% therefore reads directly as account growth on a $1000 stake.
